title: Compliance Memorandum: Disclosure and Qualified Mortgage Treatment of the Interest Rate Buydown
content:
**Subject:** how each Interest Rate Buydown product is shown on the Closing Disclosure, how it bears on the disclosed APR, whether its points count toward the qualified mortgage points and fees cap, the rate the borrower is qualified at, and the effect of a change after the Closing Disclosure.

| Product | Where the cost appears on the Closing Disclosure | Disclosed APR reflects the reduced payments when a seller or builder funds the buydown | Points count toward the qualified mortgage cap | Qualified mortgage points and fees cap | Change after the Closing Disclosure needs a corrected disclosure | Rate the borrower is qualified at |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | seller or builder credit | Yes | No | 3.00% | Yes | the note rate |
| Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown | seller or builder credit | Yes | No | 3.00% | Yes | the note rate |
| Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | seller or builder credit | Yes | No | 3.00% | Yes | the note rate |
| Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown | seller or builder credit | Yes | No | 3.00% | Yes | the note rate |
| Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | discount points | No | Yes | 3.00% | Yes | the note rate |
| Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | discount points | No | Yes | 3.00% | Yes | the note rate |
| Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown | discount points | No | Yes | 3.00% | Yes | the note rate |

The 3.00% figure is the points and fees cap for a qualified mortgage that the points count toward; the column before it says, product by product, whether the buydown's points count toward that cap.

## Discussion

1. *Closing Disclosure placement.* The cost of a temporary product appears as a seller or builder credit; the cost of a permanent product appears as discount points.
2. *APR.* When a seller or builder funds a temporary product, the disclosed APR reflects the reduced payments. For the permanent products this setting is No.
3. *Qualified mortgage cap.* The points of the three permanent products count toward the 3.00% cap; the temporary products show No.
4. *Qualifying rate.* Every product qualifies the borrower at the note rate.
5. *Changes after the Closing Disclosure.* For every product a change after the Closing Disclosure needs a corrected disclosure.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A seller funds a hypothetical Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown: the cost appears as a seller or builder credit, the disclosed APR reflects the reduced payments, and the buydown carries no points toward the 3.00% cap.
- A borrower pays for a hypothetical Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown: the cost appears as discount points and those points count toward the 3.00% cap.
- A hypothetical Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown is changed after the Closing Disclosure has been issued: a corrected disclosure is needed.
